## What's new in v0.3.0

- Added video downloads: hover a loaded video and click the download button in its top-right corner to save it to Downloads. Supports paused players, embedded frames, split pages, and player fullscreen.
- Added a Video downloads panel with download progress, completion, errors, retry, and cancellation. Repeated downloads use numbered filenames without overwriting existing files.
- Added session-aware video extraction for YouTube, Instagram, X/Twitter, and other supported sites, with bundled download tools that combine separate video and audio tracks when provided.
- Added Instagram and X/Twitter home-feed targeting so videos can download directly from their feed cards without opening the individual post.
- Added a fallback for identifiable media streams when normal webpage extraction is unavailable. Ambiguous streams, some advertisements, DRM-protected videos, and live-stream recording remain unsupported.
- Fixed the download button flickering when moving the pointer over YouTube players and transparent video controls.
- Retained the existing image downloader and browser tab features.

## Windows installers

Choose either the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** from the assets below. Both install AuraView v0.3.0 for Windows x64 and include the video download tools.
